description: Three ways to draw grouped rows in the Svelte 5 data grid plus a subtotal footer per group. groupDisplayMode='groupRows' draws a full-width banner per group, 'singleColumn' one combined Group column, and 'multipleColumns' one column per grouped field, with groupFooters closing each group with a subtotal row under the real columns. Paging counts data rows, so a page holds pageSize real rows and reprints the banners they sit under, and footers never eat the budget.

faq.question: How do I add a subtotal row under each group?
faq.answer: Set groupFooters on <SvGrid> and give the numeric columns an aggregate. The footer renders under the group's rows using the real columns, so the subtotal lines up with the values.

faq.question: What is the difference between the display modes?
faq.answer: groupRows puts a banner row above each group. singleColumn keeps the rows flat and adds one Group column showing the nested keys with indentation. multipleColumns adds a column per grouped field, which only differs from singleColumn when grouping by two or more fields.

faq.question: How does paging count grouped rows?
faq.answer: By data rows only. pageSize=20 means twenty real rows per page; the banners those rows belong to are reprinted at the top of the page and footers are inserted after paging.
